summary: This standards-track document defines a TRILL message to flush learned end-station address information. TRILL normally learns addresses by watching data traffic. A flush message lets an edge tell others to discard entries that may now be wrong.

eli5.summary: If someone moves house, the post office needs to throw away the old address. This message tells switches to forget addresses they have learned.

questions: what is the trill address flush message
how to clear learned mac addresses in trill
